QuestInfo.name: Mariwaka's Purse
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, Pipopa is so busy he hasn't had time to handle the case of Mariwaka's missing purse. Mariwaka will be devastated.
QuestInfo.1: Unwilling to wait for results, Mariwaka asked if you could locate her purse for her. She said the thugs who hang out in the alley could be the same ones who stole her purse. She also mentioned she hadn't seen any animals around the city for quite a while--which is odd, to say the least.
QuestInfo.2: When you returned Mariwaka's purse, she cried tears of joy. Come to think of it, she is an actress. Could those have been crocodile tears?

0.0: What? Still?? Oh my gosh, what am I supposed to do now? I need to find it ASAP! Oh... oh yeah! YOU can help me find it! Don't worry, I'll reward you handsomely if you find it for me. Right... I got it stolen by some thug in the alley carrying a gun. You might find it if you teach them a lesson or two. What do you think? Will you help me?

yes.0: I'll be waitng right here. That purse is very important to me.

no.0: What? You got my hopes up and then say you won't help me? What a jerk. Get lost!

yes.0: Oh wow! This is it! Thank you so much! Please take this gift. It's my way of saying thanks for all you've done.

item.0: You haven't found it yet? Argggh! Then why did you come back here? Please find my purse!
